propositions: Related pins are incorrectly classified as stale-pin-drift when the attestation is newer than the pinned dependency's last change, solely because the fingerprint generation algorithm changed while the material did not

pin_health.derive_health compares pins only against the latest fingerprint generation, lacking the historical full-hash compatibility check that attest._legacy_material_ok already applies to the ticket's own material

An unchanged prerequisite pinned under a supported historical fingerprint generation (post-330c/pre-2be7) should be classified as current when recomputed from the current related ticket state exactly matches the signed pin

The fix extends derive_health with a narrowly scoped compatibility predicate that accepts historical generations only when recomputation from current material exactly matches the signed pin, preserving current-fingerprint reporting and genuine drift detection
